lines.text: Introduction
Why SplitSync?

elements.name: Text 2
elements.text: Managing shared expenses is a universal challenge that affects millions of people daily. Whether it's friends on a trip, roommates splitting rent and utilities, colleagues sharing team lunches, or families managing household costs, the complexity of tracking who owes what grows exponentially with each transaction.

elements.name: Text 3
elements.text: Traditional methods like manual spreadsheets, note-taking apps, or even pen and paper lead to confusion, forgotten debts, and sometimes strained relationships. The lack of real-time updates and automated calculations creates inefficiencies that frustrate users.

lines.text: About the Project

elements.name: Text 5
elements.text: SplitSync addresses these pain points by providing a comprehensive, full-stack expense splitting application that automates the entire process. Built with modern technologies and designed with scalability in mind, SplitSync offers flexible expense splitting methods, real-time synchronization across all participants, and intelligent debt management.

elements.name: Text 6
elements.text: The application combines an intuitive user interface with powerful backend logic to deliver a seamless experience. Users can track expenses, split costs in multiple ways, view real-time balances, and settle debts with just a few clicks.
